recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. If SD later determines that the FHIR Person resource should also be a custodian target, that should be handled as a separate work-group decision because FHIR-50988's final Jira resolution and application commit do not add Person.
issue_request: FHIR-50988 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6 Composition. It requested changing Composition.custodian from Reference(Organization) to support patient-authored notes; the final Jira resolution says to update the target set to Organization, Patient, and Group.
initial_application: Git commit bd194bcdf65feb6b2167a34e6a02bccb912a9073 applied J#50988 by adding Patient and Group target profiles to Composition.custodian, but left the short and definition describing only an organization or group.
additional_context: Composition is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/composition/structuredefinition-Composition.xml is the authoritative current-build source. SD Confluence planning/minutes show the change came from the FHIR Clinical Documents R6 Composition tracker family. Some planning/minutes wording mentioned Person, but the final Jira resolution and applied source commit used Organization, Patient, and Group, so this reconciliation did not add Person.
reconciliation: Updated the Composition.custodian short and definition to name Organization, Patient, and Group, and updated the Composition SVG tooltip that mirrors the same definition. The targetProfile list was already correct and was not changed.
source_changes: source/composition/structuredefinition-Composition.xml: Composition.custodian short and definition now describe an organization, patient, or group custodian.
source/composition/composition.svg: synchronized the Composition.custodian diagram tooltip with the updated definition.
